facts.text: Coldrif cough syrup contaminated with diethylene glycol (DEG) — at least 16 children died in Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh

facts.text: Tamil Nadu Drugs Control lab confirmed DEG; CDSCO recommended cancelling licence; a doctor arrested

facts.text: India pharma: 3rd by volume, 14th by value; 20% of global generics; 60% of vaccine demand; exports USD 25–27 billion; supplies 200+ countries

facts.text: ⚠ India voted for ILO Convention No. 189 (2011) but not ratified it
